name: Thick-Client Application Assessment
description: Security assessment of desktop and client-server (thick-client) applications. Covers architecture and trust-boundary analysis, local data storage and secrets, inter-process communication, client-side enforcement of server-side controls, update and installer mechanisms, DLL/library loading, and interception of proprietary or non-HTTP client traffic. Testing of the backing web APIs belongs to SWSEC-WEB-API; deep binary analysis belongs to Reverse Engineering.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to thick-client application assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands thick-client architectures and their typical weaknesses
evidence: Can explain two-tier and three-tier client-server architectures and where trust boundaries lie
Understands why client-side validation and licensing checks cannot enforce server-side security
Can name common thick-client weakness classes (hardcoded secrets, insecure storage, DLL hijacking, insecure updates)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic thick-client testing under supervision
evidence: Reviewed local files, registry and configuration stores for credentials and sensitive data
Intercepted client traffic with a proxy (including proxy-unaware clients) in a lab setup
Monitored process, file and IPC activity with Process Monitor or equivalent tooling
Work reviewed by authorized tester

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses thick-client applications against a documented methodology
evidence: Independently assessed 5+ thick-client applications and reported findings with reproducible steps
Tests update and installer mechanisms for integrity and privilege issues
Identifies and demonstrates bypass of client-side authorization and business rules against the server
Tests named pipes, local sockets, COM and other IPC endpoints for unauthorized access
Passed proficiency assessment on thick-client testing

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex and proprietary clients; adapts tooling to non-standard protocols
evidence: Intercepts and manipulates proprietary binary protocols using custom proxy or hooking tooling
Combines decompilation and runtime instrumentation to defeat client-side protections (.NET, Java, native)
Scopes and leads thick-client engagements including test environment and data requirements
Reviews thick-client reports and mentors junior testers

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on thick-client security; defines lab methodology
evidence: Developed the lab's thick-client testing methodology and reporting templates
Published research or CVEs on desktop application vulnerabilities
Advises clients on secure thick-client architecture and update design
Trains teams on advanced thick-client assessment techniques

assessment_methods.description: Assess a prepared vulnerable thick-client application with a server backend, identifying insecure storage, IPC, update and client-side enforcement flaws, and report them
Observe setup of traffic interception for a proxy-unaware client and the dynamic analysis workflow
